s1.hyp: A grain of sand is about half a millimetre. A human hair is a tenth of that. And that's about where your eyes give up.

s2.hyp: A red blood cell is ten times smaller again. Most viruses are smaller still, too small for any ordinary microscope to see.

s3.hyp: An atom is a thousand times smaller than a virus. And the proton at its centre is sixty thousand times smaller than the atom.

s4.hyp: Electrons are so small that no experiment has found any size at all. Below that, physicists point to the Planck length, twenty more zeros down.

s5.hyp: Thirty -four zeros after the decimal point. Maybe that's the floor. Or maybe there isn't one.
